title: ID0385522-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2/S5 313657632001 ] Fans making noise
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Fans making clattering noise
Root cause: Power cable rubbed on the fan wheel balance weight
Solution: Power cable reattached, and cable management properly done.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: no
Warranty Status: delivered on May 21, 2024

additional_info.subject: From Customer
additional_info.body:
we recently put our new fast charging station from you into operation. We noticed that the built-in fan makes a clattering noise when it is in operation, as if it is hitting something. (Noises depend on the speed) To avoid further damage, a technician should be called in as soon as possible to stop this. In this context, the cable management system can also be checked again and correctly adjusted. There is a rubber lock cover on the rear door, which has unfortunately already been torn off. Please replace it! If you have any further information, please contact us again.
SICHAREG D was delivered on May 21, 2024!

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0385522-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2/S5 313657632001 ] Fans making noise CRM:00579001236
additional_info.body:
Hello team,
Greetings of the day!
Customer noticed that the built-in fan makes a clattering noise when it is in operation, as if it is hitting something.
We need to identify the source of the noise,
As per Our assumptions, Corrective Measures are as follows:
1. If GQ1 Fan is faulty - For this, We need to investigate and May have spares. - For schematic, You can refer to the schematic as mentioned in
Emobility_SICD_HW_FAN_Error Flag_OK Signal Lost
2. If Something is obstructing the GQ1 fan - We need to check if any wire or anything Obstacting and take corrective action
3. Loose wiring - We need to investigate and take corrective action accordingly.
4. Also, We need to check if the Filters are not dirty
5. There is no obstacle in the path of Air Circulation
Also customer mentioned that -
rubber lock cover on the rear door, which has already been torn off.
We need to investigate what exactly happened and determine if a replacement is necessary. Please let us know if you require any assistance from our side.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
